sources.source_name: Deep Dive Analysis — SASH BALANCE SYSTEM
sources.snippet: Sash Balance System - **Type**: **Coil-spring balance** (typical for builder-grade double-hung vinyl) - **Known failure mode**: Coil-spring balances lose tension over time; expected functional life **12–18 years** (vs. 25+ for constant-force) - **Symptom**: Sash becomes difficult to raise/hold in place; often occurs earlier with frequent use

bottom_line: Builder-grade vinyl. Multi-plant manufacturing with documented quality variance. Class-action lawsuit history (seal failures). Fusion-welded corners but thin vinyl profile. Contractors use for cost builds but pros warn of 10-year seal failure rates. AuraLast wood treatment on Siteline questioned.
